scripts.dev: bun run prepare-manifest && bun --bun vite dev
scripts.build: bun run prepare-manifest && bun --bun vite build && bun run copy-manifest
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --type-aware --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src scripts tests fixtures vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --deny-warnings --type-aware --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json src scripts tests fixtures vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.test: bun run prepare-manifest && bun test scripts && bun scripts/verify-curated-build.ts
scripts.test:browser: bun run prepare-manifest && bun --bun playwright test
scripts.test:browser:preview: bun run prepare-manifest && FIXTURE_HOST_MODE=preview bun --bun playwright test
